questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

4 : 80 : : 6 : ?
questions.solution:
**LOGIC**:** (First number)² + (First number)³ = Second number**

The pattern followed here is:

4² + 4³ = 80 (Second number)

Similarly,

**6² + 6³ = 252 (Second number)**

Hence, The correct answer is** "252"**.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All beds are sofa sets.

Some sofa sets are mattresses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some sofa set are beds.

II. Some mattresses are sofa sets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
**Least Possible Venn Diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8de218e778ec9cc6ef1d9dbb693d28bd15eaf901e7dade38effe37cbffbdbec.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sofa set are beds → **Follows** (All bed are sofa sets than some sofa sets are bed.Hence, it is definitely true)

II. Some mattresses are sofa sets → **Follows **(Some mattresses are sofa set than some sofa will be mattress. Hence, it is definitely true)

Hence,** "both conclusion I and II follows".**

questions.question: If N > G > E and F = E > Q = R, then which of the following options is NOT correct?
questions.solution:
Given Statements: N > G > E; F = E > Q = R

On combining:** N > G > E = F > Q = R**

Option 1) G > Q → True (G > E = F > Q)

**Option 2) F Q = R; Here, F is greater than R but in conclusion F is smaller than R.)**

Option 3) N > E → True (N > G > E)

Option 4) F > Q → True (F > Q)

Hence, the correct answer is** "F < R".**

(Assume that they all facing towards north)

(From this statement Case - 2 is eliminated, because in Case - 2 Kripal is sitting in right extreme end and it is not possible that Kripal is sitting immediate right of Ashraf)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/160c30841de4191972bee50200a873df0c6aa4ad7e8a9c8c1d9f3fdc2d53d29f.png] 

3) Lohit is second to the left of Arpan.

(According to this statement Arpan has to sit extreme right end, Because Lohit is second to the left of Arpan. It is possible when Arpan sit Right extreme end)

According to final sitting arrangement **Lohit **is sitting immediate right of **Ashraf.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Lohit".**

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some cricketers are players.

No player is a musician.

**Conclusions:**

I. No cricketer is a musician.

II. Some players are cricketers.

III. No musician is a player.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
__**Least Possible Venn diagram**__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3913219b5a634c788d75bca3c131c6de25f68c68e9023b7025db3466132cc683.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**I: **No cricketer is a musician →** Doesn't Follow **(According to the given statements Some cricketers are players and No player is a musician.so, No cricketer is a musician could be possible or not).

This possibility scenario could be shown from the Venn diagram given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06325c51a4d45bfbacffeca33f2a0eec69eb8daf08ba596483dcf4f2f7ff9d9a.png] 

From this diagram some cricketers are musician but from the least possible Venn diagram No cricketer is a musician, which mean we can not say anything definite about the relation of cricketer and musician.

**II. **Some players are cricketers →** Follow** ( From statement I, some cricketers are players it means some players are definitely cricketers).

**III. **No musician is a player → **Follow** (From statement II, no player is a musician it means No musician is a player).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only Conclusion II and III follow"**.
